close_reason: Confirmed: find_immutable_patch_key byte-index check correctly rejects paths not prefixes; no change needed
description: email.rs:714-716. The patch-key immutability check uses key.as_bytes().get(field.len()) == Some(&b'/') to distinguish three cases: exact match (e.g. 'messageId'), sub-path match ('messageId/0'), and a longer field name that happens to share a prefix ('messageIdExtra'). A plain starts_with check would incorrectly block the third case. The byte-index check is correct and the comment explains all three cases. A reviewer might suggest simplifying to starts_with without reading the explanation; the current approach is necessary.
title: find_immutable_patch_key: byte-index check correctly rejects paths, not prefixes
